chunks: Saʿd narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: A man raised his head from sajdah, then doubted before becoming fully settled in a sitting position, and he did not know whether he had performed sajdah or had not performed sajdah. He said: He should perform sajdah. I said: Then a man rose from his sajdah before becoming fully upright standing, and he did not know whether he had performed sajdah or had not performed sajdah. He said: He should perform sajdah.
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he doubts whether he performed sajdah before fully moving into the next position in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt concerning sajdah during salat (prayer). If a person doubts whether he performed the sajdah before fully settling into the next posture, whether sitting or standing, he should perform the sajdah.
